sections.label: Intro
sections.note: Studio entrance: sparse taps on the kick/bass hits, two long sweeps between black flats.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.note: Bench switchbacks: the long gaps become lanes along the five-seat bench wall, the short 8th pairs are the hairpins; passes under the bench-gallery arch.

sections.label: Pre-chorus 1
sections.note: Square spiral climbing around the folding stair tower (laps pass over each other) on the rising vocal phrase.

sections.label: Chorus 1
sections.note: Fall onto the open stage, then a three-leg staircase horseshoe (NE, SE, SW) around the 12-sided CD set piece; one fake fork.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.note: Narrow sawtooth corridor (legs of 2-4 taps) - the bench motif compressed, road 1.8.

sections.label: Pre-chorus 2
sections.note: Second, steeper spiral climb (same vocal phrase as pre 1, same spiral texture).

sections.label: Chorus 2
sections.note: Four-leg staircase loop round the terrace (ramp +5), closing over its own start.

sections.label: Jersey-club bridge
sections.note: Fall -4, then a tight NE/NW zigzag corridor (legs 4-7) on the 3-3-2 club kicks; paired risers pulse on the kick.

sections.label: Final chorus
sections.note: One long sweeping staircase across the whole map (ramp +3) with the bunny relief tower on the skyline; one fake fork.

sections.label: Dance break
sections.note: Choreography grid: sawtooth steps through rows of studio flats, then switchbacks through the studio-flat hall.

sections.label: Outro
sections.note: Descending ramp (-6) to the quiet studio, long straights.
